## SECTION 3: "DIVERGENCES & BLIND SPOTS"

**[CROWDED — COMMODITIES]**
Three sources, 9 claims, +4.54 score — this is the highest-conviction consensus in today's data. Manufacturing supercycle + reshoring + geopolitical supply risk = strong bull case. **Risk:** crowded consensus on commodities is often late-cycle. Monitor for positioning saturation. Severity: **6/10.**

**[BLIND_SPOT — COLLATERAL TIGHTENING vs. LIQUIDITY ATH]**
Howell simultaneously reports liquidity at all-time highs AND progressive collateral system tightening. Market likely sees the ATH headline; the collateral deterioration is beneath the surface and not yet in prices. This is the most actionable divergence today: **headline liquidity is bullish, but plumbing stress is building.** Relevant to V16 regime detection — a liquidity cycle that shows ATH on quantity but tightening on quality is a late-cycle signature. Severity: **8/10.**

**[CONTRARIAN — RECESSION vs. LABOR MARKET]**
RECESSION consensus is -9.0 (bearish) from a single source, yet the same source cluster explicitly calls September 2026 jobs "healthy" with rising participation. These claims are internally contradictory. The recession score likely reflects a different author/framing within the same outlet. Do not treat RECESSION: BEARISH as validated. Data asymmetry rule applies: no stress indicators firing = implicit bullish signal. Severity: **4/10** (noise, not signal).

**[BLIND_SPOT — ENERGY NON-LINEAR TAIL]**
Brent currently pricing a $20–25/bbl geopolitical premium. Source asserts record-low inventories + uncertain spare capacity = non-linear risk to $120–150 on escalation. Energy consensus shows only +0.5 (neutral). **The market is not pricing the tail.** Relevant for any energy exposure in the 25-asset universe. Severity: **7/10.**

**[BLIND_SPOT — FED POLICY NARRATIVE SHIFT]**
Sources at BEARISH -6.5 on Fed policy (i.e., hike was a mistake, no further tightening justified). If this is correct and the Fed pauses, the liquidity/crypto/equity bull case strengthens materially. Event proximity data shows N/A for FOMC days — cannot frame as pre-FOMC urgency today. Monitor for FOMC calendar update. Severity: **6/10.**
